summary: # **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** # **Petition No. 4/SM/2019** **Coram: Shri P.K. Pujari, Chairperson Dr. M.K. Iyer, Member Shri I.S. Jha, Member** **Date of Order: 30** **th** **of April, 2019** # **In the matter of:** Extension of validity of Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) due to expire between April, 2019 and October, 2019 # ** ORDER ** # **A. BACKGROUND** The Commission vide Order dated 30.09.2018 in Petition No. 8/SM/2018 extended the validity of RECs which were likely to expire between 31 st October, 2018 and 31 st March 2019 upto 30 th April 2019. The relevant extracts of the Order are quoted below:- _“_ . _4. In view of the above, the Commission in exercise of Power under Regulation 15 of REC Regulations extends the validity of RECs which are due to expire between 31_ _st_ _October 2018 and 31st March 2019 upto 30th April 2019._ _5. Accordingly, RECs which are due to expire between 31_ _st_ _October, 2018 and 31_ _st_ _March 2019 shall remain valid upto 30th April 2019._ _6. Petition No. 8/SM/2018 is disposed of in terms of the above.”_ ## **B. REPRESENTATION BY CENTRAL AGENCY ON RECs DUE TO EXPIRE BETWEEN** # ** APRIL, 2019 AND OCTOBER, 2019 ** 2. The inventory of RECs which are likely to expire upto 31.10.2019 as submitted by the Central Agency are as under:- Order in Petition No. 4/SM/2019 Page 1 |**_SN_**|**RE** **_No. of RECs will_** **_expire in the_** **_month of_**|**Cs likely to ex** **_No. ofSo_** **_likely to expi_** **_01.04.2019–_** |**pire between** **_lar RECs_** **_re between_** **_31.10.2019_** |**01.04.2019 –** **_No. ofNon- _** **_likely to expi_** **_01.04.2019–_** |**31.10.2019** **_Solar RECs_** **_re between_** **_31.10.2019_** |**_Total RECs_** **_(Solar +Non-Solar)_** **_to be expired_**| |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| |||**_RECs issued_** **_Before_** **_01.04.2017_**|**_RECs issued_** **_After_** **_01.04.2017_**|**_RECs issued_** **_Before_** **_01.04.2017_**|**_RECs issued_** **_after_** **_01.04.2017_**|| |**1**|**Apr-19**|4,169|0|79,455|0|**83,624**| |**2**|**May-19**|0|0|2,564|0|**2,564**| |**3**|**Jun-19**|4,138|0|13,674|0|**17,812**| |**4**|**Jul-19**|0|0|682|0|**682**| |**5**|**Aug-19**|0|0|12,360|0|**12,360**| |**6**|**Sep-19**|0|0|301|0|**301**| |**7**|**Oct-19**|0|0|4,545|0|**4,545**| |**TO**|**TAL FY 2019-20** **(till Oct-19)**|**8,307**|**0**|**1,13,581**|**0**|**1,21,888**| 3. From the above inventory, it is evident that 1,21,888 RECs which have been issued prior to 01.04.2017 are due to expire within the next six months. This includes 8,307 Solar RECs and 1,13,581 Non Solar RECs. The Commission is of the view that there is a need to extend the validity of RECs which are due to expire upto 31.10.2019. 4. In view of the above, the Commission in exercise of Power under Regulation 15 of REC Regulations extends the validity of RECs which are likely to expire between 1 st April 2019 and 31 st October 2019 upto 31 st December 2019. 5. Accordingly, RECs which are due to expire between 1 st April 2019 and 31 st October 2019 shall remain valid upto 31 st December 2019. 6. Petition No. 4/SM/2019 is disposed of in terms of the above.
